capabilities: Embed notes and sections whose dynamic content runs in the active note's context
Substitute current or offset dates into note names and headers
Embed text ranges anchored by line text or markers
Render and convert Quoth code blocks
Add source attribution footers and inline display
extras: Quoth rendering is opt-in and requires uninstalling Quoth first; checkboxes in embedded content are display-only and do not change the source note; embeds break if the target note is renamed.
intentEvidence: Full Quoth replacement. Dynbedded renders Quoth code blocks directly
motivation: The author created it partly to pair with plugins like Dataview and Buttons.
problem: Built-in embeds render content in the embedded note's own context and cannot target date-named notes, partial ranges or shifted dates.

relations.evidence: Full Quoth replacement. Dynbedded renders Quoth code blocks directly

summary: Embeds notes, sections or text ranges into a note and runs their dynamic content in the active note's context, with date-based names.
